x-bump-note: 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 closes `scope_kind` from a bare unconstrained string to an explicit enum: ["diff", "plan", "integration"] — the exact set both consumer copies of `_credit_from_kind_partition` (coordinator_core/coverage.py, coordinator_core/ops/review_coverage_core.py) actually handle. This change originated on the vendored copy in claude-klabauter (commit 55cbf4ede) and never reached this SSOT until now: before the bump the schema admitted ANY string — its own description even named "chunk" as an example — while the consumer asserted on a closed set, so one hand-authored record with an out-of-set scope_kind (observed: "chunk", "inline-dispatch") took down the whole coverage gate with an AssertionError before it ever reached a VERDICT line. Classified `major` per this schema's own house vocabulary (a value NARROWING, from unconstrained to closed, is the more restrictive direction — a document valid under 1.1.0 with e.g. scope_kind:"chunk" no longer validates under 1.2.0). Fixed the misleading description at the same time — it cited "chunk" as an example scope_kind despite no consumer ever crediting it. "chunk" is NOT added as a fourth enum value at this bump: whether it should ever be creditable is a policy call outside this fix's scope. 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 added the optional `reviewed_paths` array — the path set a scope_kind:diff review actually covered, so a record attests coverage instead of implying it from its sha_range time window.
description: Review-trail record — one JSON document per code-review event, written under state/review-trail/*.json (whole-document match; the record IS the whole JSON file, not frontmatter). The 8 original fields are all required; `reviewed_paths` is the sole optional property, present only on scope_kind:diff records.

sha_range.description: Git commit SHA range covered by this review (e.g. 'abc1234..def5678').

reviewer.description: Identifier of the reviewer (agent persona or worker) that produced this review.

scope.description: Description or path set identifying what was reviewed.

scope_kind.description: Category of the reviewed scope. "diff" credits its resolved SHAs unconditionally; "plan" credits only the subset independently classified as planning-artifact commits; "integration" is a recognized shape that is always skipped (never credited). No other value is accepted — the closed set both live consumer copies of _credit_from_kind_partition (coordinator_core/coverage.py, coordinator_core/ops/review_coverage_core.py) actually handle.

diff_loc.description: Lines of diff covered by this review.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session that produced this review record.

workstream.description: Workstream identifier associated with this review, or null when not attributed to a specific workstream.

reviewed_paths.description: Optional set of paths this record's review actually covered (e.g. from freeze-review-diff.py --paths), or null when not supplied. Present only on scope_kind:diff records; omitted on plan/integration records. Exists because sha_range is a time window, not a path set: on a shared branch a record written as <my-first-commit>^..HEAD silently confers coverage on every concurrent peer session's commit inside the window. The write-side refusal guard is the enforcement; this key is the honest attestation.
